Associate rented numbers with accepted compliance applications. Repeat --link
once per number, or pass the full JSON body via --data (inline or @file.json):
{"numbers":[{"number":"+14155551234","compliance_application_id":"<id>"}]}.

Usage:
  plivo numbers compliance link [flags]

Examples:
  plivo numbers compliance link --link +14155551234=<compliance_id> --link +14155556789=<compliance_id>

Flags:
      --data string        full link JSON body; inline or @file.json (alternative to --link)
  -h, --help               help for link
      --link stringArray   number=compliance_application_id (repeatable)

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
